svg.font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.title: tryfirst module architecture
svg.desc: A repo or local directory feeds internal/detect, which produces a RunPlan with per-command evidence. internal/sandbox renders that plan into one container with the model stub and the demo under --network none. internal/receipt seals the observed result. The optional host-side gate supplies a per-run token for live model calls.
